summary: Backend + Frontend testing of new Daily Practice Recommendations feature. 13/13 backend pytest cases PASS (shape, idempotency, 30-day uniqueness rotation, complete with note, post-complete idempotency, undo, history sort+total_pool=85, 401 auth on all 4 endpoints, bad-limit 400). Frontend: card renders correctly between Mass Readings and Journal preview on the (tabs) home; all interactions (expand/collapse, add note, mark complete with note shown in done state, undo back to incomplete, Journal CTA navigating to /journal with seed_title+seed_body URL params and the editor prefilling title='Daily practice — <title>' and body containing 'Reflection:' footer) all PASS. NOTE: had to restart supervisor expo to rebuild the static web export (the pre-existing static bundle at /app/frontend/dist did not include the new DailyPracticeCard component until rebuilt).

backend.idempotency_same_date: Same id returned on repeat GET
backend.30_day_rotation_uniqueness: 30 distinct practice ids across 2026-06-08 → 2026-07-07 for one user (no repeats)
backend.POST /api/daily-practice/complete: completed_at populated, note='offered for my brother' persisted
backend.GET after complete: Still same id, completed_at and note remain populated
backend.DELETE /api/daily-practice/complete: completed_at cleared, note cleared, GET confirms
backend.auth_401_on_all_4_endpoints: GET, POST/complete, DELETE/complete, GET/history all return 401 without Authorization

frontend.title: No phone after dinner
frontend.journal_editor_title_prefilled: Daily practice — No phone after dinner

action_items: (Optional) The supervisor recipe builds a static export at expo startup (`yarn expo export -p web ... && npx serve`). After any frontend code change, `sudo supervisorctl restart expo` is required for the change to land in the served bundle. This is a pre-existing setup concern, not a regression of this feature.

(Nit, non-blocking) DailyPracticeCard.tsx line 207-208: testID='daily-practice-done' wraps the entire completed block, so its inner_text contains both 'Completed at ...' and the journal/undo button labels. Consider scoping testID='daily-practice-done' to just the green-check row + note quote for cleaner assertions, with a separate testID for the actions row. Functionally fine as-is.
critical_code_review_comments: daily_practices.py (957 lines) is borderline — under the 700-line rule, but ~780 of that is the static PRACTICES literal. If it grows further, consider extracting the pool to a JSON/YAML asset.

Pool currently contains 85 practices (request says ~85 — matches). 30-day rotation test trivially satisfied since pool=85 >> 30; the recent-90-days exclusion logic also correctly prevents repeats within 90 days as confirmed by the test.
Race-condition handling on insert (try/except with re-read existing) is sound. Unique index (user_id, date) created in start_db (server.py:169).
Auth dependency Depends(get_current_user) is wired via build_router factory; 401s confirmed on all 4 routes.
Frontend component DailyPracticeCard.tsx (~496 lines, ~290 logical + styles) is clean, single-responsibility, uses Pressable+testID throughout. No deprecated React Native APIs.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — every requested checkpoint (card render, position, expand/collapse, add-note, complete with note, done state, undo, journal CTA, prefilled journal editor) passes

seed_data_creation: Backend tests create their own throwaway user (test_dp_user_<uuid>) per module and clean up daily_practices, user_sessions, users on teardown. Frontend test reused ui_test_user_1 / TEST_FE_ITER11_TOKEN via setup_iter11_auth.py.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Daily Practice feature is fully working backend+frontend. Pool size is 85 (PRACTICES list in /app/backend/daily_practices.py). Critical to restart expo (`sudo supervisorctl restart expo`) after frontend changes since it serves a static export. The 30-day uniqueness assertion is the headline test (TestDailyPracticeRotation::test_30_day_unique_rotation in test_daily_practice.py).
